notifications.title: Every routine has failed on 'usage limit reached' since about 6 Nov: no new Shorts, backlog 0
notifications.detail: The last video commit on main is 5 Nov 03:07 UTC and the last Short went out 6 Nov 07:07 IST, so about 8 upload slots are empty. The routine list shows the main video run (7 Nov 03:07 IST), the spare run (8 Nov 08:05 IST), improver, research and dashboard all ending after about 5 seconds with USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED. Tonight's auditor run (8 Nov 22:35 IST) did start, so the limit may have reset. The next main video run is 9 Nov 03:07 IST.
notifications.fix: 1. Open claude.ai → Settings → Usage and check when the weekly limit resets. 2. If it resets after 9 Nov 03:07 IST, start the 'Finance Shorts generation' routine by hand once it does. 3. Until the backlog is back to 3+, pause research, dashboard and improver (config: agents.research/dashboard/improver false) so the video runs get the usage. 4. Check the dashboard's Queue on 9 Nov morning.

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 5-9 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled at minute 13 of every hour, but GitHub ran it 5 times in the last ~27 hours (4 Nov 09:04, 17:10, 22:36; 5 Nov 03:28, 12:14 UTC). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the variant system's 48-hour views therefore have gaps of 5-9 hours, and owner alerts can arrive hours late. Tonight's auditor fix makes the 48-hour count interpolate across such gaps, so nothing is blocked; this is only about timeliness.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Check the Actions tab: Watchdog runs should appear about hourly. 2. If they stay sparse, either accept it, or trigger watchdog.yml from an outside scheduler (e.g. cron-job.org calling the workflow_dispatch API with a fine-grained token limited to Actions on this repo). Workflows are owner-only files.
